bt-r06-trial.headline: Human Written
windows: And topical CBD hasn't been well-studied. There was a short 12-week trial done, where they used a CBD skin gel, and it didn't do any better than placebo.
The gel got CBD into the blood at about the levels of the starting oral dose, 5 to 10mg/kg. The approved oral doses go up to 20 or 25mg/kg a day, so the dosing may have been too low.
Transdermal CBD also skips the liver's first pass, so less of it gets converted to 7-OH-CBD, a form that stopped seizures in mice about as well as CBD itself.
